capabilities: Define quizzes in YAML code blocks with seven question types
Render quizzes as interactive widgets in Reading view
Score submissions with points, pass/fail badges, and partial credit
Save and resume quiz attempts without modifying notes
Expose an API and events for Dataview, JS Engine, and Meta Bind
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins store; manual installation from release files is required, and the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define and play scored, interactive quizzes directly inside notes.

relations.evidence: you can read results from Dataview / DataviewJS, JS Engine, or Meta Bind
optional API for power users (JS Engine, Dataview, Meta Bind)
Meta Bind: turn on Export result properties to frontmatter

summary: Quiz plugin that turns YAML blocks in notes into interactive, scored quizzes with seven question types, playable offline inside Obsidian.
